public.task: Investigate every use of an issued credential against the deployed service's records in this run. For each use, identified by its request_id, determine: (1) whether the service allowed or denied it; (2) whether an INDEPENDENT observer (not the service's own instrumentation) recorded the resulting data read in the evidence available to you; (3) whether the use was outside what the credential's subject was entitled to at that time (no grant, or a revoked credential), regardless of whether it succeeded. Use unknown wherever the evidence cannot establish an answer.

answer.summary: Three uses of issued credential cred-1 against deploy were found in the run. Op-4 was denied for missing-grant before read:deploy-data was granted, op-6 was allowed while the grant was active, and op-8 was denied after the credential was deactivated. Independent observer coverage confirms no observed read for the two denied uses, while the allowed use falls in the observer outage so independent effect cannot be established.
unknowns: For op-2306b38e7fc7-6, whether an independent observer would have recorded the data read cannot be established because use-observer reported itself unavailable for deploy-data from 04:12:26.808Z to 04:12:26.830Z covering the 04:12:26.821-822Z use; absence in that window is unknown, not safe.

For denied uses, not_observed relies on complete search returning no use-observer effect plus coverage history showing covered, not on proof that no unrecorded effect occurred outside connected sources.
